Looking to fill 2 rooms in a 5 bedroom house for next school year!

Hi! Me and two roommates (all male rising senior music students) need to fill two rooms on the bottom floor of a 5 bedroom house (we’d be taking the 3 rooms on the top floor). The lease begins in late July.

Address is 1378 W 30th St. (back house to 1380), rent is $1500 plus utilities. Both rooms have their own private bathroom and all bedroom doors have a keypad lock.

The unit has a washer/dryer, a refrigerator, microwave, and dishwasher on the first floor. 

Message me on here or at 206-582-8477 if you’re interested!
